taskTree.name: Verification Guard
taskTree.author: corporate-brain
taskTree.notes: Reverts knowledge that became "verified" without a named human verifier, or a fact/narrative/lesson/summary/interpretation verified without evidence. Only the Corporate Brain review workflow (a human reviewer) may establish verified history.

parameters.parameter: <%= require 'json'; h = (JSON.parse(@values['Review History'].to_s) rescue []); h = [] unless h.is_a?(Array); h << { 'at' => Time.now.utc.iso8601, 'by' => 'kinetic-task', 'actorType' => 'workflow', 'action' => 'guard-revert', 'from' => 'verified', 'to' => 'needs-research', 'comment' => 'Verified without a named reviewer or without required evidence; reverted by the Verification Guard workflow.' }; { 'values' => { 'Review Status' => 'needs-research', 'Verified By' => '', 'Verified At' => '', 'Review History' => h.to_json } }.to_json %>

<%= require 'json'; { 'coreState' => 'Submitted', 'values' => { 'Audit ID' => 'AU-WF-' + @run['Id'].to_s, 'Action' => 'guard:verification-reverted', 'Entity Type' => 'knowledge', 'Entity ID' => @values['Knowledge ID'].to_s, 'Actor' => 'kinetic-task (Verification Guard)', 'Actor Type' => 'workflow', 'From Status' => 'verified', 'To Status' => 'needs-research', 'Comment' => 'Revert result: ' + @results['Revert To Needs Research']['Response Code'].to_s + ' ' + @results['Revert To Needs Research']['Handler Error Message'].to_s, 'Occurred At' => Time.now.utc.iso8601 } }.to_json %>
